release_notes: Trade P&L now accounts for broker commission and statutory charges (STT, exchange transaction charges, GST, SEBI turnover fee, stamp duty): real per-order charges via each broker's own API (Kite's virtual contract note, Breeze's trade detail, Dhan's trade history) for live trades, a flat-rate estimate for paper trades. New `charges.py`, `BrokerClient.order_charges()`. Reports page Trade Log doubles as a broker-wise trade ledger: new Broker filter, and Broker/Charges ₹/Net P&L ₹ columns (existing Export CSV picks them up automatically). Income tax on F&O trading profit is deliberately not computed anywhere in the app — it's non-speculative business income taxed annually at slab rate, not a per-trade number. `installer/setup.iss`: the legacy 32-bit-install migration no longer prompts — config.json is carried over and the old `Program Files (x86)\ThetaPrime` folder is removed automatically (via its uninstaller, with a raw folder-delete fallback).
